aiSummary: In October 2026, Chrome led browsers (mobile) in Italy at 64.37% (market share of tracked page views / usage). Safari ranked second at 28.26%, followed by Samsung Internet at 4.53%.

faqs.question: Which item leads browsers (mobile) in Italy?
faqs.answer: Chrome leads at 64.37% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/browser-market-share/mobile/italy.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for browsers (mobile) in Italy?
faqs.answer: Chrome (64.37%), Safari (28.26%), Samsung Internet (4.53%) in October 2026.
